decision_source.resolution_basis: The user selected the exact Product-approval option previously presented and supplied both immutable SHA-256 bindings.

product_approval.scope: The exact frozen and tested CAL-ONTOLOGY-AS-PRODUCT-CANDIDATE-0005-COHESIVE-LAB-SYSTEM bytes only.
product_approval.reversibility: A later explicit owner decision may supersede Product approval; this decision and its exact subject remain immutable history.

next_frontier.permitted_effect: prepare and validate one exact non-effectful admission candidate
next_frontier.excluded_effect: No admission occurs until the ontology-system owner selects a separately digest-bound admission option.

non_effects: This decision does not mutate the frozen Product candidate, ontology-system record, tests, or receipts.
This decision does not admit the cohesive ontology-system root.
This decision does not bulk-admit any child ontology, package, Definition, Artifact Type, Context, source, or implementation binding.
This decision does not select among the eleven profile-qualified domainspec-product-ontology@1 records.
This decision does not claim that the Ontology Product is realized by the D65 runtime.
This decision does not adopt or activate a runtime or Context Map.
This decision does not authorize or perform migration, cutover, source retirement, or destructive action.
This decision does not authorize publication, release, deployment, credentials, or external effects.
This decision authorizes only preparation and validation of a separate non-effectful root-admission candidate.
claim_ceiling: The exact frozen and tested cohesive Lab ontology-system candidate is approved as a Product increment. No cohesive root or child ontology is admitted, no runtime is adopted, and no activation, migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, source retirement, credential, destructive action, or external effect is authorized.
